messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — after last night's CRM import we saw ~6% drop in onboarding healthscore for accounts created in Feb. Playbook automation also retriggered for ~120 accounts. Suspect duplicate contact merges created new contact_ids and retriggered first-touch playbooks. Filed a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-4123

Raj Singh: Thanks Maya. Can you paste a sample contact id pair? I want to run a quick dedupe query.

Maya Patel: Example: external_id=acme-1234, old_contact_id=54231, new_contact_id=99214. I put a small sample in the ticket.

Raj Singh: Ok running quick check now. Preliminary looks like the import preserved external_id but created new internal ids when email canonicalization failed. Quick SQL I used:
```sql
SELECT external_id, count(distinct contact_id) as ids, min(updated_at)
FROM contacts
WHERE external_id IN ('acme-1234', 'beta-4321')
GROUP BY external_id
HAVING count(distinct contact_id) > 1;
```
That lines up with playbook triggers based on contact_id last_touch.

Lin Chen: Saw same in the onboarding dashboard — spike in playbook fires at 00:30 UTC. Dashboard: https://console.redwood/boards/onboard-health?range=24h

Tomás Rivera: Quick mitigation: add a gating rule to playbook runner to ignore automation if contact was created/changed in the last 48h by the import job (import_job_tag). Proposed change to rule config:
```yaml
conditions:
  - not(recent_import_flag == true)
  - account.healthscore < 0.6
  - last_playbook_run > 7d
```
This should prevent double-fires while we fix ids.

Maya Patel: That seems reasonable. Can you do a dry-run first and post the list of suppressed accounts? We need to notify owners for any manual interventions.

Tomás Rivera: Will run dry-run in staging now. Command I'll use:
```bash
./playbook-runner --env=staging --rules=onboard-gate.yaml --dry-run --since=2026-02-01
```
I'll paste output when done. PR: https://github.com/redwood/cs-playbooks/pull/758

CS Tools Bot: playbook-runner (staging) dry-run completed in 34s — 118 accounts would have been suppressed. Report: https://ci.redwood/reports/dryrun/758

Lin Chen: Nice. Can we also add an alert if >100 playbook suppressions happen in a 1h window? That'll catch noisy imports.

Raj Singh: Agree. I'll schedule a backfill to coalesce duplicate contact_ids into canonical_id using external_id mapping and email hash. Backfill plan:
* Snapshot contacts table
* Generate mapping external_id -> preferred_contact_id
* Update contact_id references in playbook_events (non-destructive, write new canonical_id column)

SQL skeleton:
```sql
WITH preferred AS (
  SELECT external_id, min(contact_id) as canonical_id
  FROM contacts
  GROUP BY external_id
)
UPDATE playbook_events e
SET canonical_contact_id = p.canonical_id
FROM preferred p
WHERE e.external_id = p.external_id
  AND e.canonical_contact_id IS NULL;
```
I'll run this in a dry-run mode and share results.

Maya Patel: Perfect. Tomás — after your PR merges, can we also add owner ping metadata to the suppressed report so managers see which accounts were gated?

Tomás Rivera: Yup — adding owner_email + owner_team to report. Will include a CSV export.

Maya Patel: Thanks all. Timeline: Raj to run backfill dry-run by EOD PST, Tomás to merge gating rule after one more review, Lin to add alert. I'll update ticket CS-4123 with status and owner list. :thumbsup:

Raj Singh: On it, will post dry-run output here.

Lin Chen: I'll add alert in monitoring and link to CS-4123.

Tomás Rivera: About to open final PR, tagging reviewers. :rocket:

CS Tools Bot: PR #758 merged to main by tomas — deployment scheduled for 2026-03-03 02:00 UTC.

Maya Patel: sweet. follow-up meeting tomorrow 10am PT to verify metrics.

Lin Chen: I'll bring the dashboard snapshots.

Raj Singh: Dry-run posted: https://ci.redwood/backfills/1122/logs — no unexpected rejects.

Tomás Rivera: thanks team, will watch the rollout. :eyes:
